- **Data Warehousing**: Built dimensional models for incident response metrics; supported 50+ ad-hoc queries per day with sub-second latency.  
- **Monitoring & Alerting**: Configured Prometheus/Grafana for pipeline health checks; reduced downtime by 70% through proactive threshold tuning.  
- **ETL Pipeline Design**: Standardized data flow templates for 15+ internal tools; reduced onboarding time for new engineers by 60%.  
- **Data Modeling**: Created star schemas for security event normalization; improved join performance by 50% through denormalization strategies.
